# Summary

<!-- Replace this section with your own summary statement. -->

This portfolio documents three courses developed and delivered at
Stetson University. Each course section begins with the student-facing
syllabus and is followed by week-by-week lecture notes and session
preparation materials.

The materials in this portfolio represent a unified approach to course
design: the same content serves multiple purposes depending on the
audience. Students see the syllabus, slides, and reading summaries.
The full portfolio, including instructor notes, is for professional
documentation and self-reference.
